reason: The hypothesis makes specific claims about the microstructure, cracking resistance, and property improvements of a CoCrFeNiMo HEA coating, but no prior evidence is cited to support any of these key premises. Standard textbook knowledge does not cover the behavior of this specific HEA system under laser processing.
premises: CoCrFeNiMo HEA powder can form a refined, metastable FCC+BCC microstructure under rapid solidification
Laser surface alloying with this HEA minimizes hot cracking compared to fusion welding
The HEA coating significantly enhances wear and corrosion resistance over untreated 316L
